subject: gk
question:
With reference to the All India Inter-Club U21 Men & Women Water Polo League 2025, consider the statements:

1. It was held at Mayo College, Ajmer.

2. It was conducted under the Western Naval Command.

3. It occurred between 14–18 April 2025.

Which are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3) 1 and 3 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** The **All India Inter-Club U21 Men & Women Water Polo League 2025** was held at **Mayo College, Ajmer**. This prestigious institution is known for its excellent sports facilities, making it an ideal venue for such national-level events. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• **Statement 2:** The event was not conducted under the **Western Naval Command**. Instead, it was organized by other sports authorities and stakeholders involved in water polo leagues in India. *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*
 
• **Statement 3:** The league took place between **14–18 April 2025**. These dates align with the schedule of the competition, as announced by the organizers. *Hence, statement 3 is correct.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is 1 and 3 only.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Mayo College, Ajmer:**

 
 
• **Mayo College** is one of the oldest and most prestigious boarding schools in India, located in **Ajmer, Rajasthan**. It is renowned for its excellent infrastructure and sporting facilities, including swimming pools and water polo arenas.
 
• The college often hosts national-level tournaments and events, leveraging its reputation as a center for excellence in sports and academics.
 
 
 
• **Water Polo in India:**
 
 
• Water polo is a **team sport** played in water, requiring significant physical endurance and skill.
 
• In India, water polo leagues like the **All India Inter-Club U21 League** aim to promote young talent and foster competition among clubs.
 
• **Example:** These leagues are instrumental in identifying and nurturing future athletes for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **Event Organization:**
 
 
• The event was organized by sports authorities and water polo federations in India, ensuring strict adherence to international rules and standards.
 
• The dates, 14–18 April 2025, were chosen to maximize participation and ensure smooth conduct of the league matches.
 
• The involvement of prestigious venues like Mayo College underscores the importance of such tournaments in promoting water sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Water Polo:**

 
 
• Water polo is played between **two teams**, each aiming to score goals by throwing a ball into the opponent’s net.
 
• The game requires **teamwork, strategy, and physical stamina**, making it one of the most challenging water sports.
 
 
 
• **Development of Water Sports in India:**
 
 
• Efforts to promote water sports, including water polo, have gained momentum through leagues and tournaments held across the country.
 
• Institutions like **Mayo College** contribute significantly by providing state-of-the-art facilities for such events.
